name_input: PRECISE CONCHEM PVT LTD; PRECISE CONCHEM PVT. LTD
product_summary: Manufacturer of polymerised drymix mortars, plasters, grouts, tile adhesives and repair mortars (brands SILICO CON, SILICO PLAST, SILICO FIX, SILICO TILE FIX, SILICO FLOOR, SILICO FLOW, SILICO CRETE, SILICO BOND). Real product lines per own site preciseconchem.in/products: SILICO CON dry-mix concrete M20-M100 (pre-blended cement/sand/aggregate mix -> 3824.50 ready-mixed mortar/concrete, arguably 3824.40 for cement-based mixes); SILICO PLAST polymerised drymix plaster and spray plaster (3824.50); SILICO FLOOR screed (3824.50); SILICO FIX block jointing mortar for AAC blocks and masonry mortar M10 (3824.50); SILICO TILE FIX tile adhesive Type 1/2/3 (-> 3214.10, not 3824); SILICO FLOW non-shrink micro concrete (3824.50); SILICO CRETE RCC repair mortar and Tie Rod Grout TRG (3824.50); SILICO BOND 20 L bonding agent / bonding slurry (-> 3824.40 or 3214.10 depending on formulation); gypsum plaster listed on site (-> 2520.20). IndiaMART catalogue (indiamart.com listing, GST 24AAECP8561C1ZJ = claimed PAN AAECP8561C, Panoli GIDC Plot 34, Ankleshwar, Bharuch) additionally lists Ready Mix Plaster, Ready Mix Mortar, Cement Mortar Mix, Brick Mortar Mix, Wall Putty, Silicone Coating, Silicone Paste, Pointing Mortar, Epoxy Repair Mortar, Non-Shrink Micro Concrete, RCC Repair Mortar, rehabilitation services. No cement clinker/Portland cement, lime or gypsum-based building plaster blocks are offered as such; no AAC blocks or cement articles are manufactured - the company supplies the MORTARS for AAC blocks, not the blocks.
comment: Declared 3824.40 (prepared additives for cements/mortars) and 3824.50 (non-refractory ready-mixed mortars/concretes) are CORRECT and cover the bulk of the range - the core business is factory-produced drymix mortars, plasters, grouts and screeds, which is exactly 3824.50. Declared 2523.29 (other Portland cement) is WRONG/unsupported: the company does not produce or sell Portland cement; it buys OPC 53 grade as raw material (stated on preciseconchem.in infrastructure page: 'ordinary portland cement 53 grade, classified & processed fly ash, fibres, and additives are sourced from renowned suppliers'). 2523.29 should be replaced by 3214.10 for the SILICO TILE FIX tile adhesive line (Type 1/2/3) and by 2520.20 for the gypsum plaster line, both of which are missing from the declaration. Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' is imprecise: this is a building-chemicals / drymix mortar manufacturer (B2B construction materials), not a construction contractor or DIY retailer. Trader signs: none - own plant at Plot No 34, GIDC Panoli, Ankleshwar (Gujarat), claimed 3,00,000 t/yr capacity, ISO-certified, plus a Navi Mumbai office (Plot D-171, TTC MIDC Shiravane, Nerul) and sister concern 'Spplicetek'; IndiaMART lists 'Nature of Business: Manufacturer'. Note the website carries placeholder contact data (818-758-4076, office@legit.com, 3146 Koontz Lane, California) which is template residue, not a real address - treat site contact details with caution. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at HS level: no customs line or shipping bill was examined in this check, so no code is corroborated by an actual export record. Per project rule 3 the 2523.29 mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection - company is retained with the code corrected to the factual range (3824.50 primary, 3824.40 secondary, plus 3214.10 and 2520.20 for the adhesive and gypsum lines).
